title: The Goals and Objectives of Our Respected Shaykh
subtitle: The great mission of Allah's love, self-purification and human development.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Hakimul Ummat, Mujaddidul Millat, Arif Billah Hazrat Maulana Shah Ashraf Ali Thanvi Rahmatullahi Alaihi used to say-
There are two types of oli in the world. One type of saint is those who have God in themselves. Another type is those who, in addition to being godly in themselves, are the artisans of making godly.

This second class of saints are those, in whose company the way of life of people changes, in whose company the heart is awakened, in their view, people gradually move forward on the path of becoming God's beloved servant.
Hazrat Thanvi Rahmatullahi Alaihi himself was such a great murshid - whose life was a great mission to build people.

quote.text: "If you want to be a Pir, a venerable saint, a Sufi or a dervish, then go somewhere else. Yes, if you want to become a human being, come to the friends of Allah."

bullets: Not being a pir — being human.
Not to grow up — to be a servant of God.
Not gaining recognition — correcting yourself.

sections.title: A Great Murshid of the Tradition That Makes People Allah's
paragraphs: A bright star in this great movement was Arif Billah Hazrat Maulana Shah Hakeem Muhammad Akhtar Saheb Rahmatullahi Alaihi.
He himself was engrossed in the love of Allah and one of the greatest desires of his heart was that those with whom he was associated should become Allah's worshipers during his lifetime.

quote.text: "O venerable ones! Do not become Allah's people only after I am gone; rather, become Allah's people during my lifetime, so that I may see you and find peace for my eyes and heart."

quoteAfter: A true murshid is here. He does not want to attract people to himself; Instead, they want to reach Allah.
He does not want relationship with Him to be the end of human life; Rather, through that relationship, people should develop a deep relationship with Allah.

sections.title: The main goal of our respected Shaykh
paragraphs: To lead people to the path of God's love.

Hazrat Wala Damat Barakatuhum had the good fortune of discipleship, companionship and education of Hakimul Ummat, Arif Billah Hazrat Maulana Shah Abdul Mateen Sahib Damat Barakatuhum from his childhood.

He not only acquired theoretical knowledge from the companionship of a godly murshid for a long time; Rather, through Islah, Tarbiyat, Suluk and Tasawf he gained deep knowledge, practical experience and purity.
The desire of his heart is so simple, yet so great—
bullets: that cometh unto him,
who will accompany him,
who hears his speech,
who will spend some time with him,
Who will associate with him—
sections.bulletsAfter: May the love of God Almighty be created in his heart.
bullets2: Learn to love the Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ,
And learns to develop himself as a beautiful person and a perfect believer.

sections.title: Not a Faction — the Path of Allah Is the Main Goal
paragraphs: The main thing is - who is moving towards Allah?

In this mission of Hazrat Wala Damat Barakatuhum, there is no groupism, no factions, no certificates, no fiqrabazi. His aim is not to bind people into any particular group; Rather, connecting people with God.

We have clearly seen - if a person has a relationship with someone else, yet if he comes to the company of Allah and tries to correct himself, Hazrat Wala Damat Barakatuhum says - "He is walking on the path of Allah."
If a person has love for Allah in his heart, affection for Shariat, love for Sunnah and effort to improve his own self - then it does not matter what identity he goes by.

sections.title: Purpose of Sohbat — To make people human
paragraphs: The purpose of Hazrat Wala Damat Barakatuhum's Sohbat, Bayan and Islahi Majlis is not to create a particular identity; Rather, to correct people's hearts and characters. He wants—
bullets: Let people love Allah
Let people love Rasulullah ﷺ
Let people be firm on Shariat
Let people follow the Sunnah
People give priority to the Hereafter
Let him receive the basic education of Haq and Deen from his elders
Let him correct his soul
And let him deal with people in such a way that no slave is hurt by him.

sections.title: Summary of Tasawwuf — Four Sentences
paragraphs: Hazrat Wala Damat Barakatuhum explained the profound teachings of Tasawwuf in very simple terms like this-

quote.text: "So that no servant of Allah is harmed. So that no servant's rights are violated. So that Allah's rights are not neglected."

quoteAfter: The great teachings of Tasawwuf lie in these four sentences—Hakkullah (God's Right) on the one hand, and Hakkul Ibad (Servant's Right) on the other. A person's character is perfected in the combination of not violating the rights of Allah and not violating the rights of the servant. So tasawwuf is not just the name of some deeds, some ojifa or some external identity.
bullets: Tasawuf is the correction of the heart
Tasawuf is the beauty of character
Tasawuf is the love of Allah
Tasawuf is the fulfillment of the servant's rights
Tasawuf is the purification of the soul
Tasawf is living in the way of gaining nearness to Allah.

sections.title: Our Sheikh's dream

quote.text: "To be a servant of Allah by whom Allah is pleased and by whom none of Allah's servants suffer."

quoteAfter: The dream of our venerable Shaykh is that every person who comes in his company should receive the love of Allah.

Every person who listens to his speech should look back on his life, try to correct his mistakes, be careful about prayers, obey the rules of Sharia, increase love for Sunnah, accept the Hereafter with respect and learn the basic teachings of religion from the elders.
This is his mission. That is his goal. This is the life of his reformatory service.

sections.title: Final Word
paragraphs: Looking at the life and mission of Ulama in Akabire and Deen in Bujurgan, one thing becomes very clear—
bullets: They did not come to make people their devotees;
They have come to make people servants of God;
They did not want people to be associated only with their name; They want people to connect with God;
They didn't want people to just listen to them; They want people's lives to change under the influence of that statement;
They didn't want people to just carry the identity of their friendship; They want the quality of companionship to be revealed in people's hearts, deeds, character and relationship with God.

finalStatement: To guide people to the path of Allah's love, to keep them firm on the Shariah and Sunnah, and to nurture them into people through whom no right of Allah is lost and no servant of Allah is harmed.
finalEcho: This is the mission of our Shaykh. This is his goal. This is the essence of his reformatory service.
dua: May Allah Ta'ala grant health, long life and endless blessings to our respected Shaykh Hazrat Maulana Shah Tayyib Ashraf Sahib Damat Barakatuhum; accept his knowledge, deeds, islah and service; and through his companionship and training grant us all the tawfiq to remain steadfast in His love, the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the Shariah.
ameen: Ameen, O Lord of the Worlds.
